title: Reproducible quantization artifact provenance, hashing and rollback
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Background: As we roll out FP8/INT8 quantization profiles and automated calibration workflows, production failures and subtle accuracy regressions have been traced back to mismatched quant artifacts (calibration tables, scale/offset metadata, config flags) that are not reproducibly tied to inputs. This ticket implements a reproducible provenance and versioning scheme for quantization artifacts so teams can verify artifacts, trace their origin, and rollback safely.
detailed_scope: 1) Define a canonical on-disk artifact bundle format (.qzb) that contains: model_id + model_hash, quant profile (FP8/INT8 param table), calibration dataset fingerprint, calibration seed and toolchain version, quantizer CLI args, and a human-readable provenance manifest. 2) Implement deterministic hashing: canonicalize artifact bundle bytes (sorted entries, normalized timestamps) and compute SHA-256 and BLAKE3 checksums. 3) Store artifact metadata in model-registry (metadata entries include checksums, created_by, created_at, calibration_job_id, storage_path). 4) Add CI verification that re-running calibration with identical inputs/seed produces artifact with identical hash. 5) Console/CLI support: upload/attach artifact to model version; verify integrity; view provenance; and initiate rollback to previous artifact. 6) Runtime mapping: runtime should accept explicit artifact checksum or fallback policy (latest-compatible, pinned-by-model).
acceptance_criteria: Given the same model binary, calibration dataset snapshot, and quantizer args+seed, recomputing the quant bundle produces identical SHA-256 and BLAKE3 checksums in CI
Artifact bundle is uploaded to model-registry with metadata and immutable storage path
Console displays provenance manifest and checksum for any attached quant artifact
Operator can roll back a model->artifact mapping from console or CLI; runtime successfully serves the previous artifact within 5 minutes of request
Automated test harness runs a small golden-sample evaluation (100 examples) and verifies accuracy delta within threshold before allowing artifact promotion
rollout_plan: 1) Prototype hashing and bundle format in quant-tools; 2) Add upload/verify APIs to model-registry service behind feature flag; 3) Run full CI reproducibility job on a representative subset of popular models (Llama-variant, Mistral-7B) with FP8/INT8; 4) Enable console UI for viewing provenance in canary orgs; 5) Gradual opt-in rollout to all hosted customers; 6) Add runtime enforcement and rollback mapping in runtime-1.20
rollback_steps: Operator selects previous artifact checksum in Console or CLI
System creates a new mapping entry (model_version -> artifact_checksum) flagged as rollback
Orchestrator schedules a canary route to target previous artifact and monitors latency/error/quality gate
If canary passes, orchestrator updates routing policy to fully use previous artifact; otherwise, revert mapping and surface incident
Audit log entry created with user, timestamp, and reason
risk_mitigation: Calibration datasets may be large: include dataset fingerprint only; require archived snapshot URIs for full forensic replay
Non-determinism in quantizer: capture toolchain git hash and container image digest; add deterministic-mode flag to quantizer
Backward-incompatible artifacts: runtime validates artifact schema version and refuses to load unknown formats
Storage integrity: store both checksums and enable periodic verify job that re-checks S3 objects against recorded checksums
notes: This work overlaps with PM feature request to show artifact lineage in Console (PM-412). Security must review storage of calibration dataset URIs that may include customer PII. We will coordinate with Infra for S3 lifecycle and immutability settings.

2026-03-10 — Marco Ruiz: Spike completed — canonical bundle format chosen, prototype BLAKE3+SHA256 implementation in quant-tools working locally. Found non-determinism in RNG seeding for OP-level calibrations; need deterministic-mode in quantizer.

2026-03-11 — Priya Nanda (ML Infra): Ran reproducibility job across 3 models. Two produced identical hashes; one (large KV cache warmup path) diverged. Added plan to snapshot KV-cache seed and ordering to manifest.

2026-03-12 — Security (Jonas Meyer): Requested addendum — do not store raw dataset samples in registry; only store snapshot URIs and dataset fingerprint (sha256). Also requested threat model for signing artifacts.
